# Assistant Emily (assistant-emily)

> Intelligent Lossless Markdown Proofreading, Context-Aware AI Translation, and Obsidian-Flavored Markdown (OFM) Pair-Assistant for Desktop Obsidian.

Assistant Emily is a desktop Obsidian community plugin designed for researchers, technical writers, and knowledge workers. It integrates local LLMs (Ollama, LM Studio) and OpenAI-compatible cloud proxies with a lossless syntax masking pipeline that guarantees zero destruction of Obsidian links, math, callouts, and frontmatter.

- Repository: https://github.com/sparklings/emily
- Website: https://sparklings.github.io/emily/
- Documentation: https://github.com/sparklings/emily/tree/main/docs
- License: MIT
- Version: 1.1.0a

## Key Capabilities
- **Lossless Syntax Masking**: Protects WikiLinks, tags, LaTeX math, code blocks, callouts, highlights, tasks, block IDs, footnotes, and TOC chapter timestamps (`TOCTIME`) via UUID token masking.
- **OFM Autonomous Self-Healing**: Automatically corrects heading line-padding, callout `>` prefix continuity, and transpiles leaked HTML into native Markdown.
- **Video Clipping Partitioning & Smart Chunking**: Retains TOC lists and metadata line breaks intact; strips timestamps only in subtitle transcripts; guarantees 1,800-character chunk boundary safety.
- **Deterministic Video Embed Preservation**: Re-injects dropped video embeds into the translated output.
- **Context-Aware Translation & Tone Rewriting**: 3 scopes (Full Document, Selection, Paragraph Bilingual) and 3 tones (Academic, Polite, Friendly).
- **Selection-Scoped Atomic Proofreading**: In-place replacement (`replaceRange`) with interactive diff review.
- **Device-Profile Provider Management**: Eliminates cloud sync conflicts across multiple workstations.
